Fraser-McGurk smashed an Australian record 14-ball List A fifty on his way to 122 from 63 while McSweeney also made 106, with Johnson taking five wickets
Alex MalcolmPublished: Oct 17, 2026, 5:27 AM (6 hrs ago)
South Australia 397 for 7 (Fraser-McGurk 122, McSweeney 106, Lehmann 58, Kerr 3-67) beat Queensland 271 (Hearne 121, Johnson 5-59) beat 
Jake Fraser-McGurk smashed his own Australian domestic One-Day record by thumping a 14-ball fifty on his way to a 49-ball century as South Australia thumped Queensland at the Karen Rolton Oval in Adelaide.
Fraser-McGurk finished with 122 from 63 including 10 fours and nine sixes to post his second List A century while skipper Nathan McSweeney made 106 from 103, his third List ton and his second in four innings after making 123 for Australia A against India A a fortnight ago, to help South Australia pile up 397 for 7 before Spencer Johnson took his maiden List A five-for as Queensland were bowled out for 271 in reply with Lachlan Hearne playing a lone hand in making 121.
